shortDescription: update, or destroy Automation Hub Collections.

options.name: ah_host
options.description: URL to Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_HOST) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: ah_password
options.description: Password for your Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_PASSWORD)

options.name: ah_path_prefix
options.description: API path used to access the api. For galaxy_ng this is either 'automation-hub' or the custom prefix used on install with GALAXY_API_PATH_PREFIX For Automation Hub this is 'galaxy'

options.name: ah_token
options.description: The Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub API token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the ah_token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_API_TOKEN)

options.name: ah_username
options.description: Username for your Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_USERNAME)

options.name: auto_approve
options.description: Approves a collection. Requires version to be set.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval to request an update from Automation Hub when waiting for approval.

options.name: name
options.description: Collection name. Must be lower case containing only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

options.name: namespace
options.description: Namespace name. Must be lower case containing only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

options.name: overwrite_existing
options.description: Overwrites an existing collection. Requires version to be set.

options.name: path
options.description: Collection artifact file path. If version is not specified, version will be derived from file name.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the Galaxy or Automation Hub host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource. If present with a path, will upload a collection artifact to Automation hub. If present will return data on a collection. If present with version, will return data on a collection version. If absent without version, will delete the collection and all versions. If absent with version, will delete only specified version.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Waiting for the approval will abort after this amount of seconds

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to Galaxy or Automation Hub Server. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_VERIFY_SSL)

options.name: version
options.description: Collection Version. Must be lower case containing only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

options.name: wait
options.description: Waits for the collection to be uploaded
